title: Add otpauth as a safelisted scheme for registerProtocolHandler()
body:
This commit adds otpauth to [safelisted]. Several requests for new schemes have been blocked on [blocklist] but this latter approach is not pursued in the short term. This was originally proposed in [otpauth] and the scheme is documented at [iana]. [blacklist] https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/3998 [iana] https://www.iana.org/assignments/uri-schemes/uri-schemes.xhtml [optauth] https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/2204 [safelisted] https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/system-state.html#safelisted-scheme - [ ] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * … * … - [ ] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * … - [ ] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/master/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chrome: … * Firefox: … * Safari: … (See [WHATWG Working Mode: Changes](https://whatwg.org/working-mode#changes) for more details.) *** ### :boom: Error: Wattsi server error :boom: ### [PR Preview](https://github.com/tobie/pr-preview#pr-preview) failed to build. _(Last tried on Jan 15, 2021, 8:00 AM UTC)_.
More PR Preview relies on a number of web services to run. There seems to be an issue with the following one: :rotating_light: [Wattsi Server](https://github.com/domenic/wattsi-server) - Wattsi Server is the web service used to build the WHATWG HTML spec. :link: [Related URL](https://build.whatwg.org/wattsi) ``` 504 Gateway Time-out
